6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.quote: Renna farmed well above the recorded Renna norm, scored the first kill of the game on Skylar, later killed Gadget and died only twice. Skylar finished with one kill and five deaths.
6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.issue: wrong fact: the game's first kill was Scarlett killing Renna; Renna's kill on Skylar was the team's first kill
6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.rewrite: Renna farmed well above the recorded Renna norm, scored the team's first kill on Skylar after giving up first blood, later killed Gadget and died only twice. Skylar finished with one kill and five deaths.

6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.quote: We took every recorded river buff, all three Seedlings, the Mini Prime and the only Fangtooth, took three outer towers to one and gave up four kills all game. Serath and Lt. Belica never died. The one lost fight went 1-3 right after Lt. Belica killed Gadget, and after it we still took a Seedling, an enemy outer tower and the Mini Prime. The leak was earlier: our first two clean fights, including a four-for-zero teamfight, knocked down no structure.
6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.issue: 'leak' asserts a missed tower window the feed cannot show (no wave or tower-availability data); the four-for-zero was a skirmish, not a recorded teamfight
6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.rewrite: The team took every river buff, all three Seedlings, the Mini Prime and the only Fangtooth, took three outer towers to one and gave up four kills. Serath and Lt. Belica never died. The one lost fight went 1-3 right after Lt. Belica killed Gadget, and after that fight the team still took a Seedling, an enemy outer tower and the Mini Prime. The first two clean fights, including a four-for-zero, were followed by no structure; whether a tower was reachable then is unknown.

6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.issue: attack speed 'on reappearing' appears only in the Heightened Senses menu text, not the game description
6c0a10f5-ad58-4c58-a160-a755684ad9c0.rewrite: TwinBlast was the first allied death in the lost fight, to Sparrow. Heightened Senses gives Sparrow stealth, movement speed and attack speed, so TwinBlast holds Rocket Dash until Sparrow reappears and steps out before trading back.
